about: The epistola of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: I went forth from the mouth of the Most High, the firstborn before every creature; I dwelt in the highest places, and my throne was in a pillar of cloud. I stood in all the earth and among every people, and in every nation I held the first place; and with power I trod upon the hearts of all, the exalted and the lowly. Whoever listens to me will not be brought to shame, and those who work in me will not sin. Those who make me known will have eternal life.
